stories.title: Demi Lovato agita multidão em grande show com participação de Pabllo Vittar no Rock in Rio

en.title: Demi Lovato energizes crowd in major show with Pabllo Vittar's participation at Rock in Rio
en.summary: Demi Lovato performed at Rock in Rio on Saturday with a surprise appearance by Pabllo Vittar, closing their set together with the song Cool for the Summer.

stories.title: Rock in Rio 2026: Maroon 5 fecha o 6º dia de festival; ASSISTA

en.title: Rock in Rio 2026: Maroon 5 closes the 6th day of festival; WATCH
en.summary: Maroon 5 headlined the sixth day of Rock in Rio 2026 on Saturday, following performances by Demi Lovato, Mumford & Sons, and João Gomes, with the festival continuing through Sunday.

stories.title: Zara Larsson no Rock in Rio: onde assistir e horário do show

en.title: Zara Larsson at Rock in Rio: where to watch and show time
en.summary: Swedish singer Zara Larsson performs at Rock in Rio 2026 on Sunday on the Sunset stage at 22h55 on the festival's final day, with broadcasts available on multiple channels.

stories.title: Halsey no Rock in Rio: onde assistir e horário do show

en.title: Halsey at Rock in Rio: where to watch and show time
en.summary: American singer Halsey performs at Rock in Rio 2026 on Sunday on the World stage at 21h35 on the festival's closing day, with broadcasts available on multiple platforms.

stories.title: Twenty One Pilots no Rock in Rio: onde assistir e horário do show

en.title: Twenty One Pilots at Rock in Rio: where to watch and show time
en.summary: The American band Twenty One Pilots performs at Rock in Rio 2026 on September 13 on the Mundo stage at 12:05 AM. The show will be broadcast on G1, Multishow, and Canal Bis.

stories.title: Mega-Sena pode pagar R$ 85 milhões neste domingo; g1 transmite ao vivo

en.title: Mega-Sena may pay R$ 85 million this Sunday; G1 broadcasts live
en.summary: Mega-Sena contest 3,057 offers a prize of R$ 65 million for players matching all six numbers in the draw scheduled for 11 AM on Sunday in São Paulo. The jackpot accumulated after no winner in the previous Thursday draw.

stories.title: Santos bate o Cruzeiro, engata 3ª vitória seguida e já é o 10º no Brasileiro

en.title: Santos beats Cruzeiro, achieves 3rd consecutive win and reaches 10th place in Brasileiro
en.summary: Santos defeated Cruzeiro 2-1 on Saturday in round 27 of the Brazilian Championship, with goals from Rollheiser and Fabrício Bruno. It was Everton Cebolinha's debut for the team.

stories.title: Escalado entre J. Balvin e Demi Lovato, João Gomes sai com missão cumprida do Rock in Rio 2026

en.title: Scheduled between J. Balvin and Demi Lovato, João Gomes leaves Rock in Rio 2026 with mission accomplished
en.summary: João Gomes performed at Rock in Rio 2026 as part of the festival's lineup alongside international artists J. Balvin and Demi Lovato.

stories.title: Fachin dá 24 horas para PF enviar informações sobre celular de Vorcaro

en.title: Fachin gives Federal Police 24 hours to send information about Vorcaro's cellphone
en.summary: Supreme Court President Fachin set a 24-hour deadline for Federal Police to provide information about the custody and condition of data extracted from former banker Daniel Vorcaro's mobile device.

stories.title: Fachin afasta Mendonça de caso contra Moraes e manda parar apurações de Master e INSS

en.title: Fachin removes Mendonça from case against Moraes and halts Master and INSS investigations
en.summary: Brazil's Supreme Court president Edson Fachin removed minister André Mendonça from overseeing a case involving alleged connections between minister Alexandre de Moraes and former banker Daniel Vorcaro, and suspended related investigations.

en.title: Botafogo vs Red Bull Bragantino in Brasileirão: where to watch live, time and lineup
en.summary: Botafogo plays against Red Bull Bragantino in a Brasileirão match with broadcast details and team information available.

stories.title: Mendonça defende decisão de enviar julgamento sobre Moraes ao plenário e devolve processo a Fachin

en.title: Mendonça defends decision to send Moraes judgment to plenary and returns case to Fachin
en.summary: Minister Mendonça defended his decision to refer the Moraes-related judgment to the full court and returned the case to president Fachin.

stories.title: Ataque a navio no Estreito de Ormuz alimenta temores sobre fornecimento de petróleo

en.title: Attack on ship in Strait of Hormuz fuels concerns about oil supply
en.summary: A vessel in the Strait of Hormuz was reportedly struck by a projectile on Sunday, according to British maritime monitoring services. The incident raises concerns about threats to oil supply, following Saudi Arabia's closure of a vital pipeline.

stories.title: Na TV, Lula cita caso Master e diz que PF não tinha liberdade com família Bolsonaro

en.title: On TV, Lula cites Master case and says PF had no freedom with Bolsonaro family
en.summary: President Lula used electoral programming on public security to link opponent Flávio Bolsonaro to the Master case, accusing the Bolsonaro family of attempting to interfere with Federal Police operations.

stories.title: Fachin assume caso das mensagens de Vorcaro a Moraes e pede processos do Master e INSS

en.title: Fachin assumes case of Vorcaro's messages to Moraes and requests Master and INSS proceedings
en.summary: Supreme Court President Edson Fachin took over the investigation into alleged messages sent by former banker Daniel Vorcaro to Minister Alexandre de Moraes, and requested related cases concerning Banco Master and INSS benefit irregularities be transferred to the presidency.

stories.title: Mendonça envia processo sobre Moraes à presidência do STF

en.title: Mendonça sends Moraes case to STF presidency
en.summary: Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça transferred to the court's presidency the case concerning messages allegedly sent by former banker Daniel Vorcaro to Minister Alexandre de Moraes, complying with President Fachin's directive.

stories.title: Altman afirma que o IPO da OpenAI não acontecerá em 2026 por preocupações com segurança da IA

en.title: Altman states that OpenAI's IPO will not happen in 2026 due to AI safety concerns
en.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman announced the company will not conduct an initial public offering in 2026, citing concerns about artificial intelligence safety and lack of pressure to go public.
